chapter_title: Constitution of Bangladesh & Organs of Government

questions.question: When did the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh come into effect?
questions.explanation: Adopted on 4 November 1972, the Constitution of Bangladesh came into full legal force on 16 December 1972 (Victory Day).

questions.question: What type of legislature is the Jatiya Sangsad of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: The Bangladesh Parliament (Jatiya Sangsad) is unicameral, consisting of 300 general seats and 50 reserved women seats.

questions.question: Which organ of government is responsible for interpreting laws and safeguarding the Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court of Bangladesh is the guardian of the Constitution and holds judicial review powers.

questions.question: Who was the Chairman of the Constitution Drafting Committee of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Dr. Kamal Hossain served as the Chairman of the 34-member drafting committee in 1972.

questions.question: Under which article of the Bangladesh Constitution are Fundamental Rights guaranteed?
questions.explanation: Part III of the Constitution explicitly guarantees enforceable fundamental human rights.
